data: Which line in the rightmost subplot have the highest value when all data is retained?

The question asks which line in the rightmost subplot has the highest value when all data is retained. From the caption, we know that the figure shows BLEU scores for different uncertainty estimators under various retained data rates. The rightmost subplot corresponds to 50 samples of data retained. 

Looking at the rightmost subplot (b), there are three lines representing different uncertainty estimators: BS, SP-50, and BLEUVaR-50. The y-axis represents BLEU scores, and the x-axis represents the fraction of data retained. When all data is retained (x=1.0), the line with the highest value is the one corresponding to BS. Therefore, the line in the rightmost subplot that has the highest value when all data is retained is the blue line labeled 'BS'.
